t: White screen / black screen / empty roster (usually not a deleted box)
q: white screen / black screen / empty roster (usually not a deleted box) help opens to white, black spinner after install, empty roster after reconnect.
grok bot term the official app from xai / spacexai with cursor: a roster of named teammates plus one shared cloud computer. not grok.com chat.
bot term one named teammate on your roster. it has a screen on the shared computer. creating another bot is not a security boundary.
computer term the persistent cloud machine assigned to your account. browser, files, and terminal live here. every bot can see the same logins and cookies.
screen term the work surface one bot uses on that computer. parallel screens are not isolation. one computer-use task runs per screen.
skill term a reusable how: when to use it, inputs, steps, how to verify, what to return, and what needs approval. save after a good run.
routine term a when: schedule or event on one bot. tests do real things. put sends, deletes, and payments behind approval.
teach a task term desktop recording of about ten minutes of screen actions (no microphone). the bot drafts a skill. you still add stop rules.
plugin / connector term account-level integration. prefer a connector over clicking the web. installed for the account, not locked to one bot.
mcp term remote http tools the computer can call. localhost / stdio mcp on your laptop is unreachable from the cloud machine.
share / template term a public x.ai/bot link that copies identity, skills, and routines — not your computer or logins. strip secrets before sharing.
chief of staff term community convention: one pinned bot you talk to. it proposes specialists. official docs only require name, job, and how it works.
require approval term the human gate for sends, spend, and other writes. description beats shouting stop later in chat.
weekly usage term meter on the cursor account. macos and ios share one bucket. exhaustion can spill into on-demand if that is enabled.
on-demand term shared paid overflow after the weekly pool. the app may not warn you in-product. watch the cursor usage screen.
cursor account term the only login. there is no separate grok bot account. the same account holds the plan and the usage meter. grok bot is not a cursor ide panel.
hermes term a different named-bot host. some skill packs port a roster there. a hermes profile is not a cursor grok bot.
grok.com / grok term chat, imagine, and voice. google often ranks it for “grok bot.” wrong product for this handbook.
grok build term local coding cli. not grok bot. the community app grok-app is a gui for grok build, not a bot client.
legacy privacy mode term a cursor setting that can block grok bot computer provisioning. turn it off on the account you sign in with.
warm-up: one document job five minutes a cited brief from a file you attach. no connector. no login.
morning attention list job chief of staff what changed, what needs you, and what can wait. one door, not twelve bots.
inbox to drafts job ops a sorted pile plus replies in your voice. you still hit send.
outbound research pack job sales scored accounts and review-ready drafts. no enroll, no send.
declutter audit job life a numbered list of unused mail, drive clutter, and paid subs. approval before any cut.
travel hunt job life keep-or-switch options with fees. the last click stays yours.
